mechanism: Both drugs can increase heart rate variability and cardiac conduction effects; atomoxetine has sympathomimetic properties that may counteract ivabradine's bradycardic effect, while ivabradine may potentiate atomoxetine's cardiac effects through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely; consider ECG monitoring; adjust ivabradine dose if needed; use atomoxetine with caution in patients requiring bradycardic control.
